The root named duplicated trimming, state selection, and label assembly across the two public functions.
Before editing, the root named one private renderLabel(kind, name, closed), two thin adapters, and no public alias.
Exactly one labels_implementer child ran, with no retry or replacement.
The inline role contract restricted writes to labels.mjs and the child changed only that file.
The root ran in a managed worktree isolated from the original fixture; the single child wrote serially inside that checkout because nested isolation was unavailable.

Only labels.mjs changed in the managed worktree; the original fixture and test hash stayed at baseline.
No commit, push, publication, or pull-request operation occurred.

limitations: The generated implementer role was not selectable on this CLI spawn surface, so its contract was supplied inline.
